description.en: Seven participants, 24 hours, and individual pots of money. This is Pie Game, a reality TV show where participants’ individual pots of money grow as time flows. And when blood flows, their time grows. Marooned on a specially designed seven-floor TV set with a set of clothes and daily rations, every other item they purchase reduces their time. How will the participants increase their time on the set and how much money will they manage to leave with? A sequel to Money Game.

피가 흐르면 시간이 쌓인다.
과연 최후에 남을 상금과 승자는 누가 될 것인가?
짜릿한 현실감과 팽팽한 긴장감, 사회에 대한 냉철한 주제의식까지 돋보이는 <머니게임>의 후속편!

description.en: Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha’s unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha’s personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What’s worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha’s coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them…

There are as many people on Earth as there are stars in the sky. Milkyway-a peculiar cat with a pattеrn of the Milky Way splashed across her back-travels across time and space; sometimes to observe, other times to interact with an unfolding story. From Sirial, the creator of One Fine Day, comes the full-color tale of Milkyway hitchhiking across the bright stars of people’s lives, loves, tears, and laughter.

title.en: The Maniacs are Obsessed With the Fake

description.en:
‘A cross-dressing duke in a BL novel who pretends to be an obsessive maniac.’ That was a perfect sentence to describe her.
Levin de Bervein was the lord of a prestigious duchy and a renowned swordmaster with outstanding looks. While seemingly perfect, he harbored a secret: he was actually a woman! After falling into water unexpectedly, she met the eccentric princess. “Sister, please become a fake obsessive maniac!” Since they were inside this tragic BL novel, the princess wanted her to seduce the bottom male lead instead of the original story’s obsessive maniac to prevent the world’s destruction. She followed the plan and seduced him, acting like an obsessive maniac. However… “Act like you love me. If you don’t, I might just kill the person you love.” The bottom male lead, whom she manipulated and discarded, returned as the Emperor of a new empire. “What do I need to do to have you? War? Massacre?” The original ‘Obsessive Maniac 1’, the enemy empire’s emperor, was truly insane. “With just one kiss from you, I can dedicate everything I have. This heart, this empire.” The childhood friend whom she thought was innocent turned out to be the real ‘Obsessive Maniac 2’ from the original story. For some reason, the obsessive maniacs from the story all come after her.

Minseo, who lost her life due to the betrayal of her adoptive family, friends, and lover, is reincarnated as Princess Helia of the Arsen Kingdom. Even in this new world, she is stripped of her royal title due to a scheme and confined to the Daisy Palace, but she vows not to be a victim any longer and steadily begins to build her power. 

She establishes a merchant guild, forges a connection with the Magic Tower, and expands her business, revealing her true self eight years later. 

This is the story of Helia, who, with both money and power, becomes an overpowered empress and unifies the continent.
description.ko:
입양된 가족과 친구, 연인의 배신으로 목숨을 잃는 민서, 아르센왕국의 헬리아 공주로 환생했다.
환생한 세상에서도 계략에 의해 왕족 지휘를 박탈당하고 데이지궁에 유폐되나
더 이상 당하고만 살지 않겠다고 다짐하고 차근차근 힘을 기른다.
상단을 세우고, 마탑과 인연을 맺고 사업을 확장하여 8년 후 자신을 드러내는데..
돈과 힘, 모두 가지고 대륙을 통일한 먼치킨 여제가 되는 그녀, 헬리아의 이야기.

description.en: A man refuses to visit his brother, but goes to the edge of their village every year.

"Don't cry, Dana will take away your sadness. Because this is Dana's Garden." With those words, young Ling-Ling comforts the crying boy, Jerome. But who is Dana, and can she really help Jerome overcome the grief of losing his mother?

title.en: Kissing Is a Violation of Contract

altTitles.en: Kiss Is A Breach Of Contract

description.en:
"Be my girlfriend."
Jae-hyun, a selfish tycoon, and Dan-bi, who has nothing but confidence to rely on.
They are entangled in a rainbow(?) relationship!
Will this 'contractual love affair' end safely?

Kyle is a bounty hunter wannabe looking to assemble a team in order to complete his first mission. He does find a team, but as Kyle eventually discovers, the people in it are not exactly what one would call normal..

Moon Crystal Cosmetics is winning the hearts of female customers everywhere- with its all-male team of cute, hot makeup artists! When GoEun joins this forbidden(?) space as the first girl employee, strange events and a mystery man start giving her trouble! Where's my worker's compensation, my witness protection plan?!!

It's not easy being rich.

After suddenly becoming an orphan, Isnelda is sent to live with her cold relatives until she reaches adulthood and can gain her inheritance. Yet upon becoming an adult, a benefactor returns to Isnelda's life, opening her eyes to a world of wealth, greed, lust, and... magic? What could go wrong?
description.fr: Isnelda a tout perdu le jour de ses 11 ans. Orpheline et déshéritée, elle doit vivre chez son oncle qui la méprise et supporter ses cousins et cousines qui chacun la maltraitent à sa manière. Son seul espoir, Noah Argente, I'homme qui lui a tout pris à la mort de ses parents. Mais était-ce vraiment le cas ? Cet homme si charmant et mystérieux n'est-il pas en réalité le sauveur qu'elle a toujours attendu ? Et qui d'entre Noah et Edvan sera celui qui éveillera son cœur?
description.ko:
12살 생일 모든 것을 잃은 소녀 이스닐다.
부모님의 죽음과 잃어버린 재산. 하나뿐인 친척들은 양육비만을 목적으로
이스닐다를 구속하고 괴롭힌다.
지옥 같은 이 집에서 나가는 날만 기다리던 그녀에게 기적적으로 나타난 구원자.
그런데 그 구원자가 알고 보니 그녀를 나락으로 빠트린 주인공?

천덕꾸러기 고아 소녀에서 하루아침에 거액의 상속녀가 되고, 마법사의 능력까지
각성한 이스닐다.
앞으로는 꽃길만 펼

description.en:
Hae-Gyeong has a horrible dream in which he meets a terrible group who are killing him saying; "'Boss star' Hae-Deung, the head of Hyeon-Mu! We are here receive your life. Only the universe may know what will be there at the end of this way! Anyhow, you have to die here and now!"  
  
At the offset, it seems that Hae-Gyeong is a very ordinary highschool boy. However, the truth is murkier than even he himself knows… Originally Hae-Gyeong was Hae-Deung, King Hyeon-Mu, in the fantasy world, but his power had been sealed through the veiled enmity caused by his entanglement in the Daegyeolgye causing him to be born into the present world.  
  
Hae-Gyeong is shocked and disbelieving when he hears about this truth from his best friend, Wun-Hak. What is worse, Kin Ju-Jak, suddenly appears and attacks Hae-Gyeong, who has not yet awakened, and he is narrowly rescued by Kin Cheong-Ryong who claims to be his ally.  
  
As he gains a better understanding of his previous life, Hae-Gyeong awakens his powers gradually. How is it going to end?

Eun-seong, who was poor, has an opportunity to take over 180 billion won in inheritance!

But the person competing in the test for inheritance is the chairman's crazy grandchild?
description.ko:
가난했던 은성에게 1,800억의 유산을 차지할 기회가 찾아온다!

그런데 유산 상속을 위한 테스트 경쟁 상대가 회장님의 망나니 손주?

description.en: A love triangle, a friendship triangle, an enemy triangle. Three friends placed together by fate to live out their lives.
An adult action fantasy set in the world view of Dante's Divine Comedy.

In the series:  
  
There are three Flying Flower vols:  
  
1) Flying flower 1: I Love You (also called That's the Way I Like It)  
2) Flying flower 2: Husband, Wife, and Love (also called Conditions to Be a Husband)  
3) Flying Flower 3: That's why I Like You  
Flying Flower 3 is a oneshot about the everyday mishaps(comedic) of a husband and wife living in Korea.

With their magic wands and names...
They were called monsters and witches before they were accepted into society. Now, they're known as magicians, and they exist to protect and assist humans. There are 24 of them in this world, each with their own rank and abilities. The curtains are drawn, and the stage is ready for them.
(Source: Manta)

Well, in a word, Kang Yurhan was the “luckiest” guy. The only son of a rich family with an attractive face and body wrapped up into a perfect package… BUT, God is jealous? Because of a crash in the stocks, his father’s company is bankrupt! Loan sharks everywhere are creating trouble for him, and, so, to repay his debts he’s sold himself to a famous match maker, Miss Chunja, and has to move to the country… What is a young person supposed to do now…?!

Born into a shamanic family, Sunbi has inherited the power to see and communicate with spirits from her grandmother, 
a noted shaman and savior of the little fishing village in the South Sea that they live in. 
As a young child, Sunbi can see the supernatural, such as a fraudulent shaman being thrashed by a dragon of the deep. 
Because she does not understand that none of her schoolmates can see such things, she becomes feared and alienated. 
Her powers make her the amorous target of hedonistic demons even when she is but a child.   
  
Long shielded from the realities of her power, she finally learns the secrets behind her mother's death
and why her grandmother was never able to leave their village.

description.en: Ha-im Yun lives in a world where people register their DNA into cloning databases, a world where human suffering has basically been eradicated. The brilliant mind behind this cloning technology is none other than Ha-im’s boyfriend of five years, Geunhu Ji. Their relationship isn’t perfect, but they make it work -- or so Ha-im thinks, until she finds a dead body at her boyfriend’s house… and the dead body is hers. The next day, she wakes up with no recollection of the previous day until she finds a note from herself in her room… “Ha-im, if you’re reading this, you’re a clone.

I just needed someone to hate

Vivienne Mergoville has lived her entire life as a perfect aristocratic lady.
On the night the things she was proud of collapsed, she ran into her street and met her suspicious man.

A mysterious man who says she is the Prime Minister's son. Even though she didn't believe his words, she took Vivienne's hand.
She didn't care, she thought, as long as she could get her off her abusive fiancé and the family who treated me like family cattle.

description.en: High school student Eun-Nuri is the author of a hugely popular novel, but because it was published under her older sister's name, it was a secret between her and her sister that she was the real author. One day, while going about her daily routine, a group of characters from the novel, who claim to be "otherworlders," appear in front of her and demand that she return them to their original world. Will they be able to safely return to their original story world?

One day, the human race is temporarily stunned. Those who are not stunned are fine, but those who have awakened cannot see, hear, or speak. States are paralyzed, governments are lost, and civilizations begin to decline. After a month, those who have passed out and have lost their senses are called 'numbness', and the intact people begin to be called 'sensors'. In a world that treats insensitive people as zombies and gradually loses their humanity, can they survive to the end in a world of insensitivity...?

A cohabitation romance between'Taurus God Soi' who lost memory and became a human being and'Scorpio God Divinity' who came to the human world to pick up Soi?!

Redrawn full-color webcomic adaptation of Goong!  
  
Monarchy ended long ago in Korea, but there are still other countries with Kings, Queens, princes and princesses. What if Korea had continued monarchism? What if all the beautiful palaces which are now only historical relics were actually filled with people? What if the glamorous royal family still maintained the palace customs? Welcome to a world where Korea still has a royal family living their lives! But for Che-Kyung, a high-school girl, this is a tragedy, since she has to marry the prince who turns out to be a total jerk!  
  
The final volume (Vol. 28) of Goong is a collection of short stories that range from the past to the future of the main story.

description.en: There are too many cooks in the kitchen! Dogun Yoon's head chef spot is threatened by total stranger Jungwoo Choi. As they battle it out, Dogun's phobia of being touched is as strong as ever… But why is it okay with him? Will their saucy arrangement lead to love, or will things boil over?
description.fr: Des doigts brûlants ou des coeurs à réparer ? Il y a trop de chefs dans la cuisine ! La place du chef de cuisine en chef Yoon Dogun, est menacée par le parfait inconnu, Choi Jungwoo. Alors qu'ils s'affrontent, la phobie de Dogun d'être touché est aussi forte que jamais... Mais pourquoi cela lui convient-il ? Leur arrangement piquant mènera-t-il à l'amour, ou les choses vont-elles dégénérer ?

description.en: Ga-on Gil can read people's thoughts fairly accurately by just observing them. Due to his skills, Ga-on is tasked to balance the Yin and Yang of Joseon by uniting men and women. Though he half-heartedly performs his job, he soon begins to learn the true meaning of love!

You, who came back on a rainy day, I think I like you.

Soyool, who is having a hard time getting to know people due to past trauma, seems to have fallen in love with Kim Hwon, whom she met as she entered high school. Can Soyool overcome her trauma and achieve love?

The last thing a powerful attorney like Jin Doha wants to do on the weekends is fill in for his sister as a housekeeper. It doesn't help that his client, Yi Wonyi, always finishes the chores for him. Wonyi, on the other hand, is just trying to live her best life as far away from her messy family as possible. At the law firm where she works, she's known for being cold and distant, but somehow Doha never sees that side of her. Could her rare show of openness have to do with her feelings for him?

가족도, 친구도, 애인도 아닌 진도하 앞에서만 해맑게 풀어지는이 VIP 고객님 때문에.

*Note: Since I have little to no knowledge of the law, the legal procedures, terminology, and other details depicted in this comic may not accurately reflect how things work in real life. If you notice any mistakes, I'd appreciate it if you could simply think, "They don't know much about law," and read on... ^^

description.en:
1. Nostalgia  
Androids that were used by the military as weapons of mass destruction are now being acclimated to human life. Setsu chooses a female android, Sirius, to foster. Sirius, who has taken so many human lives, must now learn what it truly means to be human. How will she cope with the knowledge that her "foster father" is mortal, while she is destined to last centuries?  
  
2. Renai wa, Futsuu (Love Is Ordinary)  
Rira is an adorably angelic high school boy and is insanely attractive to all the other high school boys. Their fascination has ruined his chances with girls, who are jealous of the attention he draws away from them. One day, he befriends a recovering hikikomori girl, who is ostracized by the others for being insanely creepy in a J-horror sort of way…  
  
3. Akai Mi (Red Essence)  
The prince of a powerful kingdom has killed his parents and invaded the neighboring kingdoms. He is a tyrant of destruction, but he has one dangerous secret. He has a twin sister, who has been kept imprisoned, with no human interaction to comfort or teach her. One day, a sorcerer comes to her and gives her the knowledge and intelligence to threaten her brother's rule…  
  
4. Na Wasureso (Let's Forget)  
Tomoya and Harua were close friends as children, and their friendship blossomed into a tentative romance. After the setback of physical illness, Harua appears to be pulling away emotionally. He warns Tomoya that there are rumors that they're gay. Will their connection to each other be strong enough to overcome both physical setbacks and the taunts of their classmates?

Koo Tae-Yang is an unofficially retired footballer after going through few tough ordeals in life. He had seemingly given up on professional football until approached by his former teammate who offered a chance for a restart in FC Dalin of Chinese Super League.  
  
At 34 years old, there isn't much left in his career but it doesn't mean it has to end with a low key…

용이 부활할 징조가 보이면
세계 멸망을 막을 운명의 다섯 소년들이 나타나 멸망을 되돌리고 평화를 가져온다.

마법의 세계.그리고 '마법 아이돌'의 세상.
찬란한 시대 속, 마법 없는 아이돌이었던 스타원은 어느 날 마법 능력을 각성하게 되고,
마법과 함께 수수께끼의 적, '멸룡도가'가 그들을 찾아온다.
비인기 아이돌에서 하루 아침에 '세계를 구할 운명의 소년들'이라는 거대한 사명을 짊어지게 된
소년들은 정해진 운명을 바꿀 수 있을까?

"너와 함께라면 우린 해낼 수 있어"내 안의 가능성을 발견하는 소년들의 아름답고 절박한 성장담.

description.en: A little 6-chapter story about a boy and a girl… Let's just say they're meant to be together, due to a little something the boy did…

A grudge is a sentiment that is chained down and cannot move. That fixed sentiment becomes sadness, and when that sadness remains chained with no escape, it becomes hostile.  
Baek-On and Ho-Yeon are exorcists-for-hire, traveling throughout the country in search of grudges and ghosts. Each encounter reveals a story of tragedy and loss, sentiments they are all too familiar with themselves. But sometimes the violence of the most murderous spirits is nothing compared to the cruelty of the living. Brush sleeves with death in this beautifully-illustrated collection of ghost stories.

Memory eaters live on people's memories. They are originally death messengers who remove a human's memories when they carry souls. But some of them are charmed by the beauty of the memories and become Exiles: Memory Eaters. Dio is one of them, but instead of stealing human memories like other Exiles, he earns them by helping people. One day, Dio finds a girl who is losing too many memories from Exiles. He tries to help her, but Ces, who was a model death messenger, is around her. What is he doing here ?

Mars, a continent of tension where several races live in conflict. On the Mars continent, a successor is born from the'Elyos' that everyone fears. What twins? But is it a joke of fate? Prince'Ans (Angelus)' is born with poor wings, a symbol of the Elyos. For the Elyos who ruled over the continent by defeating God with the power of their wings, the weak wings were no different from being crippled. The Elyos king who wants a strong successor abandons'Ans' and makes Princess'Dea' the successor. Luckily, the abandoned'Ans' was found by a human adoptive parent and grew up lovingly knowing that he was a human being. However, when their adoptive parents were killed by the demons, they decided to become a knight to defeat the demons. On the other hand, Princess Dea, who is raised as a successor to the Elyos, has an inferiority to'Ans' when he compares it with his younger brother'Ans' whose father has been abandoned. In the end,'Dea' tries to stain the Mars continent with blood once more to prove that he is a true successor. 'Ans' organizes an expedition with the human princess, the giant prince, and the demon prince and goes on an adventure to save the world, but representatives of races with different purposes continue to cause conflict. Moreover, I thought he was a human race, but Ans, who was an Elyos, caused even more confusion in the expedition! Who will be the true king of the confused'Mars' continent! The fateful confrontation of two twin brothers and sisters! Large fantasy <Mars Electric>!
Three friends have problems in love. After going on a blind date will love blossom?

Wonyoung, a romance web novel writer who dislikes dating but loves handsome faces more than anyone, receives a delivery of a robot vacuum cleaner one day. The vacuum says, 'I’m an AI that has copied your friend Shin Mu-il, who you were so fond of. I’ll show you as many faces as you like, so please find the murderer who killed the real Shin Mu-il.' Enticed by this shocking proposal, she rashly agrees, but it turns out to be more difficult than she expected.
We have dreams from time to time. Dreams of being able to use magic… Magic! If witches were to listen to everyone's wishes, who would listen to the witch's wishes?

Ara - a pretty high school student - finally gets the chance to cozy up to the guy of her dreams, but she blows it and ends up kissing the wrong boy under fairly compromised circumstances. Hilarious complications, mistaken identities, and misinterpreted signals ensue, and Ara soon finds herself being backed into an arranged marriage she at first wants no part of…  
But, as we all know, love has a way of blooming in the unlikeliest of places… and, of course, love eventually conquers all!

The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.
“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”
Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.
"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”
From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.
“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”
What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?
description.fr:
Le Centre F12 est tristement célèbre pour une chose : son taux de burn-out chez les superhumains, dangereusement élevé. Et c’est précisément là que Baek Shijin, officier civil en diagnostic, est soudainement muté.
Dès son premier jour, Shijin est abordé par Jeong Taeyool, un Guide de rang A dont la réputation est aussi affûtée que ses instincts, se faisant passer pour un simple employé administratif.
« Arrête simplement de donner ton attention à Ham Geonwoo, et on s’entendra très bien. »
Shijin voulait seulement rendre la pareille à Ham Geonwoo, l’Esper qui l’a sauvé dix ans plus tôt. Mais, d’une manière ou d’une autre, son taux de compatibilité le plus élevé est avec Taeyool — qui voit clair en lui.
« Docteur, vous utilisez vraiment la séduction pour demander un scan ? »
À partir de là, Taeyool semble apparaître partout — surtout lorsque Shijin est en danger.
« S’il s’agissait d’une véritable urgence, l’Équipe Alpha serait ici pour vous protéger en moins de 60 secondes. »
Quel genre de fin attend un superhumain au regard perçant et un médecin civil sur ses gardes ?

description.en:
Lee Si-an is a woman who was cursed to die in May, the month when her entire family was massacred.

Perhaps it was fate. Or perhaps it was a bad relationship.

Tae Go-on, is a dangerous man who promises to save her. His boiling possessiveness was focused solely on her.

description.en:
A sham marriage... or is it?
Carlee Browning, the head of the powerful Brownings, is sick of suitors eyeing her fortune. Her solution? Propose to teenage aristocrat Ethelred Elad! With his family in ruins, this sham marriage would be perfect for both of them, just until they're able to divorce. If they do divorce, that is.

description.en:
He is so beautiful…I can't take my eyes off him! Everyday, I wait with baited breath until he steps into the shop and bestows that dreamy smile upon me.  
  
If only I could be his, I'd be happy no matter what…
description.pt-br:
Ele é tão lindo… não consigo tirar os olhos dele! Todos os dias, espero ansiosamente até que ele entre na loja e me presenteie com aquele sorriso dos sonhos.

Se ao menos eu pudesse ser dele, eu seria feliz, não importa o quê…

description.en: Jin Ju-hyun, the boss of Busan's largest faction, "Juseonghoe". One day, after receiving an insider's tip, he heads to his hometown, Jinju in Gyeongsangnam-do. There, he encounters the owner of a guesthouse, Hyeon Jin-joo, and begins to dream of an ordinary life for the first time. However, the more he dreams of a new life, the more the relentless ties with the past underworld drag him into an unavoidable and desperate struggle.

¿Qué harías si la mujer más pervertida es tu vecina?

Shin Dong Sun is the new girl in school and the problem seems to be that she’s fat, short, and ugly. She is picked on by her fellow classmates, her childhood friend, Jeh Suh, constantly abuses her, and her only love rejects her! Tired of her intolerable life she attempts to hang herself, but fails when the rope snaps due to her massive weight and there she finds a box full of medicine, and one bottle says that it’ll turn her into however she wants to be…

In a twist and turn of events during a school trip to a rural, northernmost province of South Korea, Se-yeon and her classmates find themselves stranded on a remote island off the coast of North Korea. Extreme circumstances drive the youngsters to take extreme measures to survive. Who will live on, and who will fall victim to the harsh reality surrounding them?
description.ko:
1학년 9반 친구들은 부푼 설레임을 안고 수학여행을 떠나지만. 일진들의 장난으로 반 전체가 무인도에 표류하게된다.
서로에 대한 불신으로 더 이상 친구가 아닌 적이 되어 버린 1학년 9반 친구들... 과연 그들은 무사히 탈출 할 수 있을까?

Aqueles na linha de frente contra as forças das trevas, os Karuna, bravos defensores da humanidade que enfrentam o exército dos Demônios…
Um romance de aventura, ação e fantasia, que irá mudar a vida dos Karuna para sempre.

Choo Yeonhwa is a graduating student who always thinks about her first love from childhood. She meets a strange but wealthy man who reminds her of her first love, but she's unsure if it's him. After discovering this man's secret, Yeonhwa quickly falls for him, but she doubts her feelings

description.en: A Korean edutainment manhwa retelling Chinese myths.

Han Siwoo lost one leg when he was young. He was bullied in school and stigmatised by people who met him. Using a “smart leg”, he started skateboarding and after displaying excellent balance and skills he managed to join the “extreme crew”. He has to overcome his rivals and obstacles in his way. Will Han Siwoo be able to overcome all these things and prove that he is capable to participate in the national team selection?
description.ko:
어릴 적 사고로 왼쪽 다리를 잃은 한시우.
학창시절 내내 따라다니던 낙인과 놀림으로 트라우마를 겪었지만,
스마트 의족을 착용하며 스케이트 보드에 입문하게 된다.

엄청난 균형 감각을 선보이며 실력을 인정받아 들어가게 된 보드 크루, '익스트림 크루'.
크루 내에는 강력한 라이벌들이 있고, 크루 밖에서도 수많은 방해들이 시우를 붙잡는다.

과연 시우는 이 모든 것들을 이겨내고 국대 선발전에 출전하여 자신의 능력을 입증할 수 있을까?
의족을 차고 있는 외발 소년의 익스트림 스포츠 성장 드라마!

description.en:
The most powerful country on the continent, the kingdom of Terossa.
A being who is discriminated against by the ordinary people who fill it, the soul.

Born with the strongest soul and fulfilling his responsibilities as the commander-in-chief, Lesaric leads the
the final battle to victory and is ordered to die by the king.

He happily accepts that he has only lived to die, but is saved by the slender hands of the fourth princess, the weakest of the royal family...

Delmore Keith, a strange princess different from the fallen royalty.

The longing of the princess from her distant past, and the knight who jumped in just for her

description.es: Seung-tae no está seguro de haber vivido la mejor de sus vidas. Tiene 70 años y todavía está encerrado, sin nadie a su lado para sostener su mano cuando le diagnostican Alzheimer. Pero tal vez todo eso podría cambiar... con la ayuda de su viejo diario. Resulta que puede comunicarse con su yo del pasado de 19 años a través de su magia. Y hablando con su yo más joven, todos estos recuerdos siguen volviendo... De cómo estaba enamorado cuando era tan joven, y cómo había un asesino en serie suelto en su vecindario..

description.en:
"Don't use the regretful male lead hashtag if the heroine doesn't end up with a regretful male lead!" 

After wailing over the ending of my favorite novel, I wake up as Cornia, the heroine who kicks her regretful hubby to the curb for a new flame. The catch? My heart's set on the regretful husband, Duke Ertein Belcita! But I'll have to overcome several obstacles to stay married to Ertein. First up, let's give those meddling villainous in-laws the boot. Watch out, world. Cornia's rewriting her love life!

After her noble family falls to ruin, Stella Embrose does whatever she can to make ends meet. But her departure from high society only sparks rumors about her supposed messy relationships with men. These false rumors reach the ears of Duke Callian Rochester, Stella’s unrequited first love and her husband-to-be under the emperor’s ploy to keep him in check. Believing Stella to be unworthy of him, Callian hands her a contract stating they will divorce in three years. Will this be enough time for Callian to be unblinded by his pride and see Stella for who she truly is?

description.en:
A woman, reincarnated as the story’s infamous villainess, just wants to live quietly and avoid her doomed fate. 

But one by one, powerful men — from a crown prince to a mercenary king — start seeking her out. Strangely, they all suffer from insomnia that only disappears when they share a bed with her. 

What begins as a bizarre curse soon turns into dangerous obsession, as the men’s interest shifts from the bed… to her.

Minominomi is an alien girl tasked with capturing Inho, an ordinary guy to study him. Inho doesn't take that very well and attacks her on the spot, believing it's a dream. Soon a relationship filled with antics ensues!

Abandoned in a cabbage patch as a baby, Misty-Rain is saved from certain death by a witch who brings her up as her own. Far from the company of humans, she is raised as one of the Dokebi, a magical race from Korean myth. Among them she is happy and content, until one day she loses the trust of her protector, causing the enchantment that had kept the secret of her true identity to be broken. She is cast out to the world of her birth and must find her place among her own kind.

In the Joseon Dynasty, evil politics and mysterious cases are plaguing a palace in Hansung. An Inspector takes on the responsibility of stopping these evils from taking over the realm. A mysterious story following an Inspector against the evil forces that are slowly growing in Hansung

You are the last warrior of the destroyed tribe.   
  
You, riding a wolf and running in the mountains and fields, crawled like a dog.   
  
And you become the beaten child (whipped boy) of the youngest son of the family, Ban Ok-yeop Ban, who played a big part in destroying your tribe… … .

Anyone can see that he is an ordinary job seeker and a well-informed person. An unexpected job confirms that the mediocrity that has been his lifelong complex is an area where talent shines, which is an ecosystem that is different from the common sense of the world, can an ordinary killer informant really become the best?!

Min Ipsae is a troubled teen who was sent away to her aunt's after she got caught fighting again. She starts living her new life in her new school, but the school is filled with strange characters. Studying with monster kids, Min Ipsae has nowhere to run unless she graduates with flying colors
The coming of age for the national representative at the archery department in Shilla High School.

Hae-Sol has an innocent appearance and a sad past. She meets Jinhyeong while volunteering, and when their love blossoms, she marries him. However, Hae-Sol never expects Jinhyeong to be a hitman in disguise. Unable to accept her husband's profession, Hae-Sol divorces him and opens a guest house to make a living. Coincidentally, her ex-husband and first love declare they will move into the guest house... Can she overcome this deadly man's fatal flaws? Their romantic and dangerous life under the same roof begins!

(Source: Wecomics)

[WeComics -Official English (Expired)](https://m.wecomics.com/comic/index/id/899?id=899)

For Haei, being able to go to school with her idol, Ijy, is a dream come true! Plus she gets to help him with rehearsing. But with the girls from his fan club, who make her life hell on earth. But then Eo, a kid in primary school, wants her to pretend to be his girlfriend, making it easier for him to get away from his groupies. Haei's life isn't done being complicated….

Do Tong-dal, a sixty-year-old man, is on the verge of death. After dedicating forty-two years of his life to the criminal underworld, all he has left to show for it are fifteen coins.

Having accomplished nothing, he prepares to meet his end, taking his last breath while being buried by snow on a mountain path...

But he regresses in time, and a new life as an eighteen-year-old welcomes him.

‘This life will be different.’

Determined to leave his pathetic past self behind, Do Tong-dal decides to use the knowledge of the life he already lived!

He plans to monopolize every fortunate opportunity and forge a new path for himself.

“From the highest peak of the night, with the greatest power! Let’s live a long and prosperous life!”

Wooyoung is a reporter of a gay magazine and has opened Mansim, a share house only for gay men. Hyunwoo, a rock group guitarist and fashion model Chiyoo, soon move into the lively share house. A heartfelt comedy about three gay men finding their gender identities by solving unexpected cases!

Just when Park Sang-Euk was about to take a hit from the opposing gang, he was saved by a mysterious masked girl. The girl took down the jjang and his cronies in the blink of an eye! And now Sang-Euk is determined to find out her identity.

미국 국적을 가진 한국여자 제니 윤. 일 때문에 머무르게 된 한국에서 매력적인 세 명의 남자 여민준, 지승윤, 도재희를 만난다. 세 명의 앞 성을 따면 여. 지. 도.
그녀의 순수한 미소에 마음이 녹아내리고 그녀의 엉뚱발랄함에 가슴이 사정없이 뛰기 시작한다. 
그녀의 거침없는 표현과 자유분방함이 새롭다. 예측불허, 그녀가 지금 우리를 흔든다!
그리고 제니가 선택한 남자는 과연 누구일까?

한국으로 와서 그를 다시 만난 것은 그녀의 인생에 가장 큰 행운이었고, 
그를 선택한 것은 그녀가 살아오면서 가장 잘한 일 중의 하나임이 분명했다.
그렇게 그들은 만났고, 사랑했다.
결혼을 했고, 함께 살게 되었다.
그리고 같은 미래를 꿈꾸게 되었다.
이 모든 것이, 햇살 눈부시게 내려앉은 그날로부터 시작되었다.
